subject: Marta Velasquez
query: Background check on Marta Velasquez, CTO of Lumen Robotics

documents.title: Profile: Marta Velasquez
documents.content: Marta Velasquez has served as chief technology officer of Lumen Robotics since 2019. Under her leadership the company shipped three generations of warehouse automation hardware. Velasquez holds a doctorate in mechanical engineering and sits on two university advisory boards. Colleagues describe Marta Velasquez as a demanding but fair manager who mentors junior engineers.

documents.title: Lumen Robotics CTO honoured
documents.content: Marta Velasquez received an industry innovation award for her work at Lumen Robotics this spring. The award committee praised the company's safety record and its open-source contributions. Velasquez said the recognition belongs to the whole engineering organisation.
